points.name: Puerto Rico Convention Center
points.address: 100 Convention Boulevard, San Juan, PR 00907
points.hotelDemandRationale: Largest convention facility in the Caribbean; drives group blocks, meeting compression, and year-round event-related room nights in the Convention Center District.
points.notes: Coordinates per Wikipedia / PRCDA venue listing (18°27′10″N 66°05′33″W). Verified against official PRCC address.

points.name: Centro Médico de Puerto Rico
points.address: Centro Médico de Puerto Rico, Barrio Monacillos, San Juan, PR 00935
points.hotelDemandRationale: Territorial tertiary-care hospital complex (ASEM) supporting patient, family, specialist, and medical-education travel demand.
points.notes: Official government medical campus administered by ASEM. Coordinates from ASEM physical address / Tren Urbano Centro Médico station reference.

points.name: University of Puerto Rico — Río Piedras Campus
points.address: 14 Ave. Universidad Ste. 1401, San Juan, PR 00925
points.hotelDemandRationale: Largest UPR campus (~18,600 students) generating graduation, conference, visiting faculty, and family-stay hotel demand.
points.notes: Coordinates per Wikipedia / Wikidata (18°24′10″N 66°03′00″W).

points.name: Coliseo de Puerto Rico José Miguel Agrelot
points.address: 500 Avenida Arterial B, Hato Rey, San Juan, PR
points.hotelDemandRationale: Caribbean's largest indoor arena (~19,500 capacity); major concerts and sports events create compression nights near the Golden Mile.
points.notes: Coordinates per Wikipedia (18°25′39.78″N 66°03′41.01″W). Managed by ASM Global / PRCDA.

points.name: Santurce Entertainment District — Calle Loíza Corridor
points.address: Calle Loíza, Santurce, San Juan, PR
points.hotelDemandRationale: Santurce nightlife, dining, and arts corridor (Loíza / McLeary) supporting weekend leisure and experience-driven hotel stays in Condado-adjacent submarkets.
points.notes: District centroid along Calle Loíza; coordinates approximate block-level center of the entertainment corridor.

points.name: Old San Juan Historic District
points.address: Viejo San Juan, San Juan, PR 00901
points.hotelDemandRationale: UNESCO-listed colonial core and primary cruise-walkable tourism demand generator for heritage, dining, and short-stay hotel product.
points.notes: District centroid near Plaza de Armas / cruise pier interface; NPS manages adjacent fortifications.

points.name: Condado Beach
points.address: Ashford Avenue waterfront, Condado, San Juan, PR
points.hotelDemandRationale: Flagship urban resort beach along Ashford Avenue; anchors Condado's luxury hotel corridor and leisure rate positioning.
points.notes: Coordinates from Puerto Rico Beach Finder listing for central Condado Beach access.

points.name: Hato Rey Financial District — Golden Mile
points.address: Avenida Ponce de León / Roosevelt corridor, Hato Rey, San Juan, PR
points.hotelDemandRationale: Primary metro office and banking core ('Golden Mile') driving weekday corporate transient and negotiated-account demand.
points.notes: Centroid along Ponce de León office corridor; block-level approximate.

points.name: Pan American Pier — Port of San Juan
points.address: Calle Lindbergh, Isla Grande, San Juan, PR 00907
points.hotelDemandRationale: Homeport cruise terminal and maritime logistics node supporting crew, pre/post-cruise, and port-adjacent commercial lodging demand.
points.notes: Coordinates at Pan American Pier 1 East entrance; Puerto Rico Ports Authority jurisdiction.

points.name: Capitol of Puerto Rico (El Capitolio)
points.address: 1 Plaza de la Democracia, San Juan, PR 00902
points.hotelDemandRationale: Seat of Puerto Rico's Legislative Assembly; generates government, legal, and institutional travel to Puerta de Tierra / Old San Juan fringe.
points.notes: Coordinates per Wikipedia NRHP listing (18°28′1″N 66°6′21″W).

points.name: Distrito T-Mobile
points.address: 250 Convention Boulevard, San Juan, PR 00907
points.hotelDemandRationale: 476k SF entertainment-retail district with Aloft hotel, dining, and event venues adjacent to PRCC; blends leisure, group, and compression demand.
points.notes: Coordinates per Wikipedia / Discover Puerto Rico (18°27′18″N 66°05′31″W).

points.name: Convention Center District — Navy Frontier Pier Growth Area
points.address: Navy Frontier Pier area, Convention Center District, San Juan, PR
points.hotelDemandRationale: PRCDA-led waterfront revitalization (Navy Frontier Pier, boardwalk, mixed-use) signaling future hotel and entertainment demand east of PRCC.
points.notes: Approximate centroid of planned Navy Frontier Pier redevelopment area; coordinates not yet tied to a single built anchor.

points.name: Castillo San Felipe del Morro
points.address: 501 Calle Norzagaray, Old San Juan, San Juan, PR 00901
points.hotelDemandRationale: Iconic NPS fort and UNESCO World Heritage component; top visitor attraction driving day-trip and heritage-stay demand in Old San Juan.
points.notes: GPS coordinates published by NPS for Castillo San Felipe del Morro entrance.

points.name: Isla Verde Beach — Balneario de Carolina
points.address: Isla Verde, Carolina, PR 00979
points.hotelDemandRationale: San Juan metro's primary resort-beach strip adjacent to SJU airport; dense hotel/casino corridor with family and transient leisure demand.
points.notes: Part of San Juan metropolitan demand market; municipality Carolina. Coordinates at Balneario de Carolina public beach access.

points.name: Hiram Bithorn Stadium
points.address: Ave. Franklin Delano Roosevelt, Hato Rey, San Juan, PR
points.hotelDemandRationale: Historic 19,000-seat baseball stadium hosting winter league and special events; supplements coliseum-driven sports/event compression in Hato Rey.
points.notes: Coordinates per Wikipedia / NRHP listing (18°25′0″N 66°4′23″W).

points.name: Plaza Las Américas
points.address: 525 Ave. Franklin Delano Roosevelt, Hato Rey, San Juan, PR 00918
points.hotelDemandRationale: Caribbean's largest shopping mall (~1.9M SF) drawing regional retail tourism and supporting adjacent Hato Rey hotel demand.
points.notes: Coordinates per Wikipedia (18°25′19″N 66°4′28″W).

points.name: Universidad del Sagrado Corazón
points.address: Calle Rosales esq. Calle San Antonio, Parada 26 1/2, Santurce, PR 00914
points.hotelDemandRationale: Major private university (~5,200 students) in Santurce generating commencement, visiting-student, and cultural-event lodging demand.
points.notes: Coordinates per Wikipedia (18°26′33″N 66°03′31″W).

points.name: Coca-Cola Music Hall
points.address: Distrito T-Mobile, 250 Convention Boulevard, San Juan, PR 00907
points.hotelDemandRationale: Primary concert hall within Distrito T-Mobile; drives event-night compression for metro San Juan hotels.
points.notes: Venue within Distrito T-Mobile complex; coordinates approximate main entrance within district footprint.

points.address: 2 Calle San José, Old San Juan, San Juan, PR 00901
points.hotelDemandRationale: Territorial tourism agency headquarters in historic La Princesa building; proxy for government-led tourism promotion activity in Old San Juan.
points.notes: Coordinates approximate La Princesa / PRTC headquarters on San José Street, Old San Juan waterfront.

points.name: Ashford Avenue Resort Corridor — Condado
points.address: Ashford Avenue, Condado, San Juan, PR
points.hotelDemandRationale: Condado's luxury hotel, casino, and dining spine combining corporate transient and high-rate leisure demand.
points.notes: Corridor centroid along Ashford Avenue between La Concha and Vanderbilt; block-level approximate.
